items.title: How many boundary values does a test suite actually need to check?
items.description: The discount bug lived at exactly one threshold ($100). The moment a second, independent threshold (free shipping at $50) was added, testing only the first boundary told you nothing about whether the second was correct. Drag the slider to see how many boundary-exact test cases a suite actually needs as more independent thresholds get added to the same function — each one needs its own check, since passing one never implies another is correct.
